verdict.rationale: vLLM's own server publishes a machine-readable FastAPI OpenAPI schema by default; it can be turned off with --disable-fastapi-docs. It also exposes Swagger UI and ReDoc explorers, with an offline mode for air-gapped setups. However, the spec only exists on a running instance: there is no downloadable static spec file, and the docs never state the /openapi.json path. Missing for 10: a published static OpenAPI file downloadable without deploying a server, documentation of the literal schema path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
